description: Agent Labor Verification: submit a timesheet with the shift or schedule record it answers to: the timesheet with its reference, the worker, the first and last day it covers, its rounding increment in minutes, its total hours, each entry with its id, the day worked, the clock-in and clock-out, the unpaid break minutes and the hours claimed, and each weekly total with the day its week starts; the schedule with its reference and each scheduled shift with its day, start and end. The signed report gives the timesheet and the schedule, each day claimed against the scheduled days, each pair of clock entries read for overlap, the hours each day claims against the time its clock entries cover, the difference between each entry’s hours and its clock time read for direction, and each weekly total and the timesheet total recomputed from the days, and counts them, and names a divergent timesheet: hours claimed on a day never scheduled, overlapping shifts, a gap inside a claimed shift, rounding that always runs one way, and a weekly total that does not recompute from the days; then an entry outside the timesheet period and clock times outside the scheduled shift, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No entries, no scheduled shifts, no clock times, no hours beside clock times, or no weekly total or total hours leaves those points unverified. Clock times read as hours and minutes on the day worked, a clock-out at or before its clock-in runs past midnight, hours compare to the hundredth, differences inside the rounding increment (a quarter hour when none is stated) read as rounding, and a week is the seven days from its stated start. This reads hours worked after the work is done, a timesheet entry by entry against its shift record. Verdict labor_timesheet_divergent, labor_timesheet_partial, labor_timesheet_unverified or labor_timesheet_consistent. POST /api/labor-timesheet-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
